text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Gyaaaah! It's a giant buuuuug!! B-Bug 
spray! Someone bring bug sprayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait...! I'll let it escape 
outside...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Bug... please come out. Ah—it's going 
deeper and deeper...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...You're scared too, aren't you? It's 
okay—I'll wait for you, no matter how long 
it takes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning, I spotted Curren Bouquetd'or, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Curren Bouquetd'or couldn't get 
a good rest... After hearing the details, 
I thought to myself how typical of her it 
was.
